name: PCMFlow
description: Lightweight audio decode and PCM flow library for Arduino. Decodes audio input and produces formatted PCM (8-bit unsigned / 16-bit signed, mono/stereo) into an internal ring buffer. Device-, codec-, and task-independent. Bundled decoders: WAV, MP3, FLAC.
keywords: audio, pcm, decode, i2s, dac, esp32, wav, mp3, flac
